optional_host_spider_census.notes: The downstream census used Spider validation under a host path. Container runs should not depend on this path; use in-repo fixtures first. Bounded Spider gold stats may consume a later checked-in sample or an operator-mounted corpus.

optional_wide_menu_capacity_fixture.note: T-D synthetic wide catalog for multi-digit menu capacity. Not part of load_fixture_bundle(); T11/T12 gold-stats and handoff digests stay pinned to tct_fixture_join only.

note: Join fixture for T11/T12 golds. Band width remains 256; SQL menu capacity is width^max_menu_digits (2 → 65536). Wide synthetic catalog lives under wide_menu_capacity/ (db_id tct_fixture_wide_menu) and is NOT loaded by load_fixture_bundle.
